issue.title: voice.transcribe deterministic fallback smoke fails when local STT is unavailable
issue.actual_behavior: `voice.transcribe` with `fallback_mode=deterministic` still raises a local STT missing error when `faster_whisper` is unavailable in `auto/local` mode, so the documented deterministic smoke path fails.
issue.expected_behavior: When `fallback_mode=deterministic` is requested, `voice.transcribe` should return deterministic fallback output even if local faster-whisper is unavailable, without making hosted-provider calls.
repro_steps: Run `PYTHONPATH=src python -m voice_comms_chip.spark_hook voice.transcribe --input examples/voice_transcribe_fallback.json --output <tmp>` on a machine without `faster_whisper`.
Before fix: returncode is 1 with `Local faster-whisper transcription is the default ... not installed`.
After fix: returncode is 0 with `mode=deterministic_fallback` and a bounded fallback reason.
issue.affected_workflow: voice.transcribe deterministic fallback smoke and degraded/offline operator validation

evidence.before_after_proof: Before: deterministic fallback example returned a missing faster-whisper error. After: the same example returns deterministic fallback transcript and no hosted transcription call.

proposed_fix.approach: In the local-STT unavailable branch, return deterministic fallback response when `fallback_mode=deterministic` instead of raising the local-missing ValueError. Add regression test ensuring no hosted call is attempted.
proposed_fix.tests_or_smoke: python -m pytest -q tests/test_spark_hook.py -k 'deterministic_fallback or voice_transcribe_prefers_local_faster_whisper_without_openai_call_when_available or voice_transcribe_uses_local_by_default_and_does_not_silently_fallback_to_hosted_when_local_missing'; PYTHONPATH=src python -m voice_comms_chip.spark_hook voice.transcribe --input examples/voice_transcribe_fallback.json --output <tmp>; python -m py_compile src/voice_comms_chip/spark_hook.py tests/test_spark_hook.py

review_claim.duplicate_notes: Checked active JUMPERZ PRs #19/#20/#21 and their maintainer feedback on 2026-06-01; none address deterministic fallback behavior when local STT is missing.
review_claim.risk_notes: Change is limited to fallback behavior in the local-missing transcribe branch and one focused regression test. No provider secret handling, Telegram routing, memory policy, or identity logic changed.
